evidence.V1: Front, three-quarter and silhouette read instantly as a spear: leaf head, winged socket, collars, banded grip and knob butt all break the outline; top view is a dot as expected for a long weapon, and A15 symmetry X/Y = 0.0.
evidence.V2: Clear tiers: big = leaf head + long haft, medium = gold socket with wings, haft collar and butt cap, small = three ink grip rings with lighter teal spacers.
evidence.V3: Proportions are only partly stylised: the head is narrow and short (~20% of 8.2 studs) on a long thin haft, wings are stubby slabs; reads closer to realistic than to a confident chunky kit shape.
evidence.V4: Consistent chamfers catch light on blade edges, socket rim, collar, wing tops and butt cap (socket and butt studio close-ups).
evidence.V5: Close-ups show smooth socket cone, haft and blade; no pinches, seams or z-fighting; only low-segment polygonal outlines on collar/butt rims, same as kit; 0 flipped faces, 0 cap overlaps, 0 self-intersections.
evidence.V6: Disciplined: gold accent, teal in two values, ink rings, steel blade; colourways (crimson, shadow) swap only the hue.
evidence.V8: One white vertex-colour material, kit gold/ink/steel + one hue, chamfers and smooth shading match the kit anchor.
evidence.V9: Studio line: Tool Handle at grip origin, Hull collision, CanCollide off when equipped, Massless, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic.

artifacts: none blocking; low-segment polygonal outline visible on butt knob and collar rims in close-ups
top_fixes: Push stylised proportion: wider, longer leaf head (about 25-30% of length) and slightly thicker haft
Give the socket wings more shape (taper/curl or flared tips) instead of flat slabs
Add a couple of segments to the butt knob and collar rims to soften the polygonal outline
